subject.title: Add auth sync command or auto-sync for API key rotation across agents

question: Should OpenClaw solve API-key rotation shadowing by explicitly updating auth profiles, warning/doctor-repairing profile shadows, or falling back from failed stored profiles to env/config keys?
rationale: The source-backed issue is real, but each proposed solution changes credential propagation, auth precedence, or failure recovery semantics for provider credentials.

options.title: Prefer explicit repair/update path
options.body: Add a user-invoked auth profile update or doctor/status repair flow that makes affected agents visible and updates only selected credentials with focused security tests.

options.title: Approve automatic sync
options.body: Allow config/env key changes to propagate into agent auth stores automatically, accepting a larger secret-copy surface in exchange for less operator work.

options.title: Approve runtime fallback
options.body: Let failed stored credentials fall back to env/config keys, accepting more dynamic auth behavior and requiring clear auth.order and audit semantics.

recommendation.title: Prefer explicit repair/update path
recommendation.body: Add a user-invoked auth profile update or doctor/status repair flow that makes affected agents visible and updates only selected credentials with focused security tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision sits on the auth-store, auth-order, and SQLite migration boundary where steipete has the strongest recent merged history.
